descriptionHtml:
Download: https://github.com/Pentarctagon/HullModIndustrialServices/releases/latest/download/hull-mod-industrial-services.zip
Source: https://github.com/Pentarctagon/HullModIndustrialServices
Changelog: https://github.com/Pentarctagon/HullModIndustrialServices/blob/master/changelog.md

The full details are in the README over on Github linked above, but as a short description this mod adds a new Hull Mod Services colony structure which then lets you do the following (all using credits):
  • Add s-mods, remove s-mods, or enhance built-in hullmods. The cost to do so is increased or reduced by the colony's ship quality that's above or below 100%.
  • Decreases ship restoration (d-mod removal) costs when quality is above 100%.
  • When ship quality is at least 150%, you can make unrestorable ships be restorable.
  • When ship quality is at least 150% and you have the post colony crisis Tri-Tachyon deal in place, you can integrate or de-integrate AI cores.

Feedback welcome - this is my first Starsector mod so there's probably some bugs, but I've already fixed everything I found during my last playthrough so hopefully there aren't too many things I've missed.
aiDescription: Adds a new Hull Mod Services colony structure which allows players to add s-mods, remove s-mods, or enhance built-in hullmods using credits. The cost of these actions is adjusted based on the colony's ship quality relative to 100%. It also decreases ship restoration costs when quality is above 100%, allows unrestorable ships to become restorable at 150% quality, and enables AI core integration or de-integration at 150% quality with a specific Tri-Tachyon deal.
